description: This file defines an interface 'CommandResponseSender' within the 'org.eclipse.hono.client' package. It specifies a contract for sending command response messages, including a method 'sendCommandResponse' which sends a response and returns a future indicating the outcome, supporting tracing via 'SpanContext'.

classes.name: CommandResponseSender
classes.description: An interface for sending command response messages, extending MessageSender, and providing the method 'sendCommandResponse' for sending responses with tracing context.

methods.name: sendCommandResponse
methods.description: Sends a command response message with optional tracing context, returning a Future indicating success or failure.
